escalations.description: The practical task (problems p.2) refers to фиг.1 (orbit of the lighter star, to be drawn on) and фиг.2 (radial-velocity curve), but the archived problems document is two pages of text only — neither figure is printed anywhere in it. A human should check the original PDF / archive folder for a missing third page or a separate figure sheet; the gold JSON attaches only the solutions' фиг.1–3 (solutions p.10–12), which show the finished answers, and carries a caveat.

The reference data at the foot of problems p.2 print „Видим ъглов диаметър на Слънцето δ = 30′“ — the same value as for the Moon. Transcribed verbatim; a human may want to confirm on the PDF whether this is the intended value (the older reference transcription claims other 2001 papers print 32′ for the Sun).

summary: The sonnet candidate is the only one close to the pages and is the base of the gold JSON; it needed the omitted „Справочни данни“ block restored, three silently fixed source typos and the v1′/v2′ label put back verbatim, and four figure boxes recomputed from ink bounds (its p2-fig1 and p5-sol-fig3 crops clip labels, p2-sol-fig1 swallows two text lines). The haiku candidate is OCR-grade garble with cross-problem contamination and a phantom figure, and the glm candidate drops Задача 3, duplicates the practical task under two numbers and leaves two solutions incomplete that the source has, so all three fail. Of the 28 checker findings, 21 are true positives; the glm checker invented one printed reading („обобщавайки“), excused a candidate typo as printed, and flagged the preserved source typo „пълнолуне“ as an error, while the haiku checker raised one non-defect as critical.
